summary: Iteration 4 focused testing of (A) expandable Virality Score factor explanations and (B) Deep Analysis persistence to the public report, plus full regression smoke. Backend: 66/66 pytest tests pass (including 5 new persistence tests in test_deep_analysis_persist.py covering auth 401/403, 404 bad id, run+persist, GET campaign, PUBLIC /api/report inclusion, and absence for campaigns that never ran DA). Frontend: all 5 factor rows toggle correctly (aria-expanded flips, reasons appear/disappear, chevron rotates, score/bar/weight% always visible, weak-factor warning icon exactly on score<55), compact bars on dashboard/experiments list unaffected, persisted DA renders immediately with Re-run (no Run button), run+persist shows 'Deep Analysis saved to report' toast and survives reload, public report renders read-only report-deep-analysis with Heuristic vs AI/agreement/difference, and a campaign with no DA shows no section. Full wizard regression (product->audience->goal->platforms->generate 9 angles->select angle->expand factors->deep analysis->angle rewrite->run launch->real metrics->resynth->learning->share report) passed end-to-end with ZERO console errors. Theme light/dark persists across refresh (ll_theme).

minor.issue: Uses direct key access doc["score"] / doc["angle"] — a campaign document missing either key would raise KeyError -> 500 instead of a 4xx. Not reproducible with current data, defensive-only.

issues: Horizontal overflow of 18px: the header action row (div.flex.items-center.gap-2 containing copy-link-btn / download-report-btn / report-new-experiment) extends to x=408 on a 390px viewport, clipping the 'New experiment' button. Pre-existing (not introduced this iteration); Experiment Detail at 390px has 0 overflow. Suggest flex-wrap or shrinking the header actions at sm.

The 'AI 2nd Opinion' number is hardcoded to color var(--score-strong) regardless of value, so a weak AI score renders in the 'strong' green (observed AI 48 vs heuristic 73, and AI 30 vs heuristic 57). Inconsistent with the heuristic/factor colour bands used everywhere else — apply the existing scoreColor(res.ai.overall).
Toggle button hit area is only ~20px tall, below the ~44px recommended touch target. Expansion still works; consider vertical padding on the button.

action_items: Report.jsx: fix 18px horizontal overflow of the header action button row at 390px (flex-wrap / smaller buttons).
DeepAnalysis.jsx: colour the AI 2nd Opinion number with scoreColor(res.ai.overall) instead of hardcoded var(--score-strong).
Optional: increase ViralityScore factor-toggle vertical padding for a >=44px mobile touch target.
critical_code_review_comments: campaign_deep_analysis: consider doc.get("score")/doc.get("angle") with a 400/409 when the campaign has no stored angle/score, to avoid a KeyError 500.
DeepAnalysis.jsx readOnly && !res branch ('No Deep Analysis was saved') is currently unreachable because Report.jsx only mounts the component when c.deep_analysis is truthy — harmless but dead code.

ViralityScore.jsx: reasons list is unmounted when collapsed (AnimatePresence), so screen readers see aria-expanded=false with no hidden content — acceptable, but note the reasons are not in the DOM for search/print. Printing/downloading the report will omit collapsed explanations.
